items.name: app-view
items.title: App view
items.description: A full-window product view with no site header or footer: a top bar across the window, a side panel and the main region below it, and an optional bar docked at the bottom, such as a media player or a status bar. layout="phone" makes it a phone app screen: edge to edge with no card or inset, the top bar optional, safe-area aware, and the tab-bar block docked at the bottom. Copy-only: paste the files `atom63 template app-view` prints.
items.docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates

items.name: chat-page
items.title: Chat page
items.description: A full-page AI assistant: past conversations in the sidebar with a new chat button, the open conversation in a reading-width column, and the composer at the bottom. With no messages it is the start screen: a large greeting, the composer and suggestion chips. Uses the chat-panel block for the conversation; wire it to @atom63/agent or any runtime through props.
items.docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat panel
items.description: An AI assistant beside the product: a side panel with a header, the transcript (user bubbles, plain assistant replies with tool steps, typing dots and copy and feedback actions), a start screen with suggestion chips when the conversation is empty, and the composer with send and stop and the AI disclaimer. ChatThread is the same conversation without the panel, for a full page. Wire it to @atom63/agent or any runtime through props.
